'''Lureia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was born during the [[Republic Dark Age]].

==Biography==
Lureia lived on a frontier world that continually changed hands during a [[Second Charge Matrica|conflict]] between the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]], and as a result of the invasions, all of Lureia's family were [[Death/Legends|killed]], except for her teenage sister. However, in c. [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], when Lureia was aged about ten, her sister was also killed. For a week Lureia lived in panic, until she was discovered by talent scouts working for the company [[Industrial Heuristics]], who believed that Lureia had the potential to become an expert at [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] design. Lureia was subsequently sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]], to serve aboard an [[arxeum]], a type of mobile university dedicated to war sciences, which Daiman had acquired from the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] Sith Lord [[Ayanos Bactra]]. However, the arxeum was destroyed during the [[Battle of Gazzari]], and Lureia and the other prospective students fled the planet with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], aboard the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']]. Whilst aboard the craft, Lureia spent all of her time in her bunk, folding and refolding a blue-colored headband that had belonged to her sister
